card.name: Space before cycle length in days
card.fires_on: The space just before a number of days that defines a treatment cycle, mostly 28 (also 21 or 7), as in 'repeated 28-day cycles'. It fires in oncology dosing schedules.

modes.label: Before cycle length
modes.description: The space after 'repeated' or 'of a' and before a number like 28-day or 21-day cycle.

modes.label: Before days off or maximum days
modes.description: The space before a day count such as 7 days off or a 28-day maximum.

card.plain: It marks the spot right before a cycle length in days, like 28-day cycles, in cancer drug dosing schedules.
